session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend from the Open to Trading Range'. Reading: gap-down open with a 3-bar bear micro-channel (bear trend from the open) into 7534; double bottom at the lows started a 50%-retracement bull trend (axis note: beginning Thursday 2nd July) that bull-breakout ran into a large shaded midday range 7550-7570 (tight range limit-order trading) with MM bull breakout at 7570 and successive double tops; afternoon bear breakout / MM bear breakout broke the range, a tight bear channel vacuum selloff tested support 7535-7540, and a small late bull close recovered to 7552. trading_range_bear_breakout (v1.3): most of the session is the shaded range and the afternoon resolves it downward.
